data.title: bn-2twx: perf/strace parsers match real producer output (audit batch)
data.description: 8 audit-found parser divergences vs real perf 7.1.4/strace 7.0 (7-field CSV, JSON/LF split writes, socket-fd '->' regex, futex unfinished/resumed across edges, SIGSTOP frames, interleaved fsync, dir fsync family, 16MiB cap). Security checks intact; fixtures corrected to real output. Also fixes 3 bn-3f7n fixture regressions. unittest 46/46, runner 163/163, verifier 187/187, evaluator SELF_TEST_PASS.

data.reason: APPROVED. Reviewed the full diff: each of the 8 relaxations matches empirically-confirmed real perf/strace output (7-field CSV verified on host; JSON-then-LF split writes verified; UNIX-STREAM annotation with '->' verified). Only shape/format checks relaxed; pid/fd/sha256/count/result/nonce and the boundary sha256 binding (canonical_json unchanged) all preserved. #7 dir-fsync family cannot leak across families (markers proven non-overlapping). #8 keeps sha256/byte-length as integrity authority. Fixtures corrected to real producer output. bn-3f7n fixture regression fixed (release 81->83, t0<=release<=last_completion). All suites green. open_findings=0
